div.head: II Eg 4.1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe þonne to ðam andagan gelæst næbbe, læde hine to Rome ⁊ þærto eacan XXX pænega, ⁊ bringe þonne þanon swytolinga, þæt he þær swa micel betæht hæbbe; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gylde þam cynge hundtwelftig scill'.

⁊ se þe hine to ðam andagan gelæst næbbe, læde hine to Róme ⁊ þærto eacan XXX pænega, ⁊ bringe þænne þonon swutelunge, þæt he ðær swa micel betæht hæbbe; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gylde þam cynge hundtwelftig scyllinga.
Et qui non persoluerit ad terminum illum, deferat eum Romam et etiam XXX den., et afferat inde significationem, quod tantum ibi reddidit; et cum redierit domum, emendet CXX sol.

⁊ se ðe hine to ðam andagan gelæst næbbe, læde hine to Rome ⁊ ðarto eacan þrittig p', ⁊ bringe þonne switelunge þæt he þar swa micel betæht hæbbe; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gilde þam cyninge hundtwelftig scill'.

And he who has failed to make payment by the appointed time shall take it to Rome, and 30 pence in addition thereto, and shall bring thence evidence that he has there handed over that amount; and when he comes home, he shall pay 120 shillings to the king.

Und wer (ihn A D) dann zu diesem Termin nicht entrichtet hat, trage ihn nach Rom und dazu 30 Pfennig mehr und bringe dann dorther eine Urkunde, dass er dort so viel abgeliefert habe; und wenn er heimkommt, zahle er dem König 120 Schill.

And whoever has not paid (it, A D) by that day, let him take it to Rome and 30 pence more besides, and then bring back from there a document showing that he has handed in that much there; and when he comes home, let him pay the king 120 shillings.
div.note: Instituta Cnuti I 9a–c has a parallel Latin version (with 40 shillings to the king).
